custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'white patch' on the wing. While some Ringlet variations have this, AI often generates irregular, melting white blobs. Verify if the white patch has a defined boundary or if it bleeds into the brown. Also, scrutinize the leg visibility; AI often hides missing legs by angling the subject or blurring the contact point.
image_description: A close-up macro photograph of a Ringlet butterfly (Aphantopus hyperantus) perched on a green plant stem. The butterfly's wings are held closed, displaying the ventral side which is light brown/tan with distinct white patches and black-ringed eyespots (ocelli). The body is fuzzy/hairy and brown. The background is a soft, out-of-focus green.
